messages:
lena: Heads-up — CloudVendor is requiring an auth header rename for marketplace integrations next quarter. We need a partner-facing deprecation plan + a soft fallback path. Who can own the comms + SDK shims?

sam: I can take SDK shims. plan: ship a compatibility proxy lib (node + python), add a feature flag, and emit telemetry. timeline?

lena: thanks. target public announce 6 weeks from now, deprecate after 90 days. want a staged rollout with grace proxy for partners in that window.

jaz: Partner CS — will coordinate targeted partner emails and support playbook. need sample comms and FAQ. also can run a tabletop for top 5 partners.

mike: Security check — proxy must not log secrets and should validate signatures. Add HSM/KMS guidance for partners using private deploy.

sam: noted. proxy will: accept both headers, prefer new header, and log a deprecation metric only. code sketch: 
```js
// pseudo
if (req.headers['x-new-auth']) use(req.headers['x-new-auth']);
else if (req.headers['x-old']) migrate(req.headers['x-old']); // increment deprecation counter
```
We’ll add a toggle: REDWOOD_PARTNER_PROXY=true

olga: Docs: I’ll draft the migration guide + FAQ. Need exact header names and recommended curl examples. also update marketplace listing text to mention backward compat through the grace proxy.

lena: header names: `x-rw-auth-v2` (new) and `x-rw-auth` (old). Please validate spelling — want consistency across SDKs and marketplace.

sam: adding feature flags and env vars to SDKs. Will publish alpha proxy to npm/pypi with semver pre-release tag. Can we gate auto-upgrade for dedicated partners?

jaz: yes please. For top partners we will coordinate a managed migration window and optionally deploy the proxy for them.

mike: add an audit log entry when proxy downgrades header to old format. Ops may want a rollback path.

olga: drafting sample comms: short email, one-pager, migration checklist, CLI snippet. will share in ~48h.

lena: @partner-bot can we get a list of active marketplace partners and their contract contacts? need to prioritize.

partner-bot: Sure — pulling marketplace partner contact list: 42 partners found. DMing prioritized list to @lena.

sam: blocker: driver for on-prem partners — some run air-gapped infra and cannot pull new packages. propose we ship a static shim patch (single binary) and provide signed artifact + checksum in release notes.

mike: good call. add signature verification step in docs and recommend offline install steps for air-gapped customers.

jaz: tabletop scheduled for next Tue 10am PT. I’ll invite top partner leads + eng reps.

lena: ops checklist to finalize:
- announce timeline and FAQ (olga + jaz)
- publish proxy alpha & migration guide (sam + olga)
- security review & sig assets (mike)
- partner outreach + tabletop (jaz)
- marketplace listing update (olga)
- telemetry & deprecation metric (sam + eng-infra)

If you want to be added to the RSVP for table-top or own a checklist item, reply here. :rocket:

sam: I’ll own proxy alpha + telemetry.

olga: Docs + marketplace text.

mike: security review + sigs.

jaz: outreach + tabletop.

lena: perfect. I’ll consolidate into the public partner runbook and post the announce draft next week. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
